text:
Alex C.: Heads-up: Cortina Health renewal due 06/30. Procurement pinged us about a mismatch between the PO and billed entity. Need to align quickly so onboarding expansion doesn't slip. :alarm_clock:
Maria F.: Which entities are involved?
Devon S.: PO came from Cortina Inc (US). Contract/billing is Cortina Health LLC. PO number is PO-987654.
Olivia O.: They want onboarding earlier if the seats are approved. Asking for 15 additional seats (so 45 total). Training team can do an earlier cohort if billing is resolved.
Alex C.: Current seats = 30. Sales wants protection on renewal pricing for first 30; addons billed at list. Finance requires correct billing entity on PO or an amendment.
Maria F.: Finance can't process invoice without matching entity. Options: reissued PO or one-page invoice-entity amendment signed. Reissue is faster. @procure-bot any suggested messaging?
procure-bot: Suggested buyer message:
```
Please reissue the purchase order naming "Cortina Health LLC" (EIN: 12-3456789) as the billing entity and reference PO-987654. If you are a VAT-registered EU entity, please include VAT registration and billing address.
```
Devon S.: I'll ask the buyer now. Also flagged that they requested net60; finance said net30 or standard net45 is max.
Priya L.: Legal: amendment path is fine but needs exec signoff and will take ~48 hours. That could push onboarding.
Olivia O.: We can tentatively reserve a training slot the week of 6/24 if they confirm seat counts by 6/21 and PO by EOD. Otherwise we might need to move to the next cohort.
Alex C.: Proposed flow: ask procurement to reissue PO today (fast). If they cannot, send DocuSign one-pager amendment and expedite exec sign. Devon please ask buyer for timeline now.
Devon S.: Message sent: "Can procurement reissue the PO to Cortina Health LLC (EIN included)? If not, we'll send a one-page amendment via DocuSign to align invoice entity and preserve the onboarding slot"
Maria F.: Finance note on proration: seat true-up from 30->45 prorates on 6/30. Example calculation (monthly billing):
```
15 added seats * $150/seat = $2,250 prorated for the month of June (full-month charge if add-on effective 6/30)
```
Alex C.: Include that line in the quote and in the amendment. Training cost to be quoted separately.
Priya L.: I'll draft the amendment now and post to #legal-review for sign-off. Tagging exec for quick approval.
procure-bot: DocuSign template queued: AMEND-INVOICE-ENTITY-1PAGER v3. Will auto-fill EIN and prorate lines when Maria uploads numbers.
Devon S.: Buyer replied: they can reissue the PO but asked for a sample invoice showing our billing tax ID and addresses. Asked for PDF sample now.
Maria F.: Uploading sample invoice with billing EIN and billing address. Also added VAT notes for EMEA entity. Sending to buyer.
Olivia O.: Buyer confirmed procurement can reissue by EOD once they receive the invoice sample and seat counts. I'll tentatively mark the training cohort as "pending PO".
Alex C.: Actions: Devon 1 send reissued PO when it lands, Maria 1 finalize quote + sample invoice, Priya 1 finish amendment draft if reissue fails, Olivia 1 hold training slot tentatively. I'll update thread when PO arrives or amendment is sent. :thumbsup:
Devon S.: PO reissued and attached: PO-987654-reissued.pdf (billing entity = Cortina Health LLC). Forwarding to finance now.
Alex C.: Excellent. Once finance confirms processing, we can finalize onboarding and seat add-on. Thanks everyone.
